question.problem: A sphere has a surface area of $25\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}.$ Calculate the diameter of the sphere.
question.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $S=25\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}$ into the formula, we can solve for $r$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ 25\pi  & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ \frac{25\pi }{4\pi } & ={r}^{2} \\ {r}^{2} & =\frac{25}{4} \\ r & =\sqrt{\frac{25}{4}} \\  & =\frac{5}{2}\,\text{mm}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the diameter is

$$
d=2r=2\cdot \frac{5}{2}=5\,\text{mm}.
$$
